description: Patient identifier
Rheumatoid arthritis status (1 = RA, 0 = healthy control)
Age in years
Gender (F = female, M = male)
Body mass index (kg/m²)
Smoking status (1 = current smoker, 0 = non-smoker)
Disease duration in years (0 for healthy controls)
Rheumatoid factor status (1 = positive, 0 = negative)
Anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody status (1 = positive, 0 = negative)
C-reactive protein level (mg/L)
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (mm/h)
Tumor Necrosis Factor alpha - Pro-inflammatory cytokine involved in systemic inflammation
Interleukin 1 beta - Mediator of inflammatory response and involved in cell proliferation, differentiation, and apoptosis
Interleukin 6 - Functions in inflammation and maturation of B cells, primarily pro-inflammatory in RA
Interleukin 8 - Chemokine involved in neutrophil recruitment and angiogenesis
Interleukin 10 - Anti-inflammatory cytokine that inhibits production of pro-inflammatory cytokines
Interleukin 17A - Pro-inflammatory cytokine produced by Th17 cells, promotes synovial inflammation
Interleukin 18 - Pro-inflammatory cytokine that induces IFN-gamma production
Interferon gamma - Activates macrophages, important in innate and adaptive immunity
Monocyte Chemoattractant Protein 1 - Recruits monocytes, memory T cells, and dendritic cells to sites of inflammation
Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor - Stimulates angiogenesis and vasculogenesis
